details:
- CVE-2026-82720: pop each reply off the mesh reply list before it is
  dropped or answered, detach the tcp_req_info and DoH stream references
  and clear the h2 stream mesh states when a DoH session is dropped, so
  an RPZ drop or jostled query can no longer leave a dangling DoH stream
  reference that is used after free
- CVE-2026-77955: do not serve or write to disk a zonemd-check zone
  while its ZONEMD verification is still pending; the zonefile write is
  deferred to the ZONEMD callback and done only if the zone verified
- CVE-2026-85501: bound the DNSSEC work per validation (ReTrap): add the
  val-validation-attempts and val-hash-attempts limits (default 32),
  limit DNSKEY/RRSIG and DS key-tag matches and NSEC/NSEC3 records
  checked, shorten oversized referral DS RRsets, stop validator restarts
  once the limits are hit, and require only the answer and authority
  sections to be secure; the built-in val-clean-additional default is
  now no, the shipped unbound.conf keeps val-clean-additional: yes
